## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 89 captures during April 2019. The activity record indicates that session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. This provides the operational context for the activity reported for the month. The available figures describe the number of captures completed and the results subsequently identified through image review and grading.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 8 ungradable image sets. The ungradable rate was 9.0 per cent. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be graded and therefore provides an indication of the images requiring consideration when reviewing monthly performance. The reported ungradable total and rate are presented together for clarity.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 6 days. This is the median interval recorded between the image being taken and the grading outcome being available. Taken together, the grading figures summarise the number of referable results and the time taken for review during April 2019. The report records no departure from the planned session lists other than routine leave.
